rationale: Theft from the person in Naples on 2026-07-14 falls inside the covered trip and appears covered under wording section 5, but the required police report has not been supplied (claims manual section 5: refer with a document request, do not approve on a promise to send it later). Request the Carabinieri report (Italian original is acceptable) from the customer within 30 days, and confirm it was made within 24 hours of the theft. If it is, the claim looks payable: backpack $90, tablet $450, rain jacket $150 (capped at the $150 Economy per-item limit) and sunglasses $130 total $820, less the $100 deductible, for $720.
